name: World Auto Feeder
summary: Hate manually feeding animals to breed them? This mod automatically feeds them from nearby chests, so you can breed them without lifting a finger.
description: # World Auto Feeder ![World Auto Feeder cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/auto-feeder/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp) Tired of manually feeding animals for breeding? Auto Feeder does it for you! ## Features - Animals are fed automatically from nearby chests. - Only feeds animals in pairs to ensure breeding partners. - Checks chests when you interact with them and periodically. ## How It Works Place a chest near your animals (within 8 blocks). Fill it with appropriate food (wheat for cows, carrots for pigs, etc.). The mod automatically feeds animals in pairs when they're ready to breed. Watch your farm grow! ## Supported Animals - **Cows** - Wheat - **Sheep** - Wheat - **Pigs** - Carrot, Potato, Beetroot - **Chickens** - Seeds (wheat, melon, pumpkin, beetroot) - **Horses** - Golden Apple, Golden Carrot - **Rabbits** - Carrot, Golden Carrot
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
